SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. ____
S. I. M. P. SIBRY
No. S. B. Station 60 C
Date November 8, 1938

Subject Communication dated 29-10-38 from the British Consulate-General
concerning Mr. A.E. Poliansky.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford. D. I.

Andrey Evgenievitch POLIANSKY, Russian, born on
October 14, 1913 at Verhneudinsk, Transbaikal Province, Siberia.
He is reported to have arrived in Shanghai from Manchuria in
1932. According to his own statement he resided in Harbin from
1923 together with his parents. In 1931 he graduated from a lo-
cal school , after which he attended the Y.M.C.A. school for chauf-
feurs for about 6 months.

In Shanghai he served in the Russian Regiment, S.V.C.,
for 3 months, after which from September, 1932 to August, 1937 he
was employed with the China General Omnibus Co, as a ticket in-
spector. He left this position on his own wish and with a good te-
stimonial. At present he is employed with the Shanghai Power Co,
as a fireman.

He is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Commit-
tee, 118/1 Moulmein Road, and with the S.C.G. Police Bureau (Reg.
No. 6919 ) and at present resides at 372 Avenue du Roi Albert,
Apt. 14, together with his brother, Vassily E. Poliansky, employed
of the Shanghai Telephone Co., and sister, Miss Lydia E. Poliansky.

Applicant holds certificate of good character issued
by the French Police on 6-7-38 ( No 35 ).

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
against this person.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

D. C. ( Special Branch ).

特务科第一股
报告
档案号 ____
S. I. M. P. SIBRY
编号：特务科第 60 C 号站
日期：1938年11月8日

事由：英国总领事馆于1938年10月29日发来的关于 A.E. Poliansky 先生的公函。
由副督察普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）呈报。经督察克劳福德（C. Crawford）转呈。

安德烈·叶夫根尼耶维奇·波利扬斯基（Andrey Evgenievitch POLIANSKY），俄国人，1913年10月14日出生于西伯利亚外贝加尔省上乌丁斯克（Verhneudinsk）。
据报他于1932年从满洲抵达上海。据其自述，他自1923年起与父母一同居住在哈尔滨。1931年他从当地一所学校毕业，随后在基督教青年会（Y.M.C.A.）司机培训学校学习了约6个月。

在上海，他在俄国义勇队（Russian Regiment, S.V.C.）服役3个月，之后从1932年9月至1937年8月受雇于中国公共汽车公司（China General Omnibus Co.），担任查票员。他是自愿离职，并持有良好的推荐信。目前他受雇于上海电力公司（Shanghai Power Co.），担任司炉工。

他在莫尔海姆路118/1号俄国侨民委员会登记，并在法公董局警务处登记（登记号 6919），目前与其弟瓦西里·E·波利扬斯基（Vassily E. Poliansky，受雇于上海电话公司）及妹妹莉迪亚·E·波利扬斯基小姐（Miss Lydia E. Poliansky）共同居住在阿尔伯特王路372号14室。

申请人持有法国警察机关于1938年7月6日签发的品行良好证书（编号 35）。

工部局警务处档案中无此人的不良记录。

A. 普罗科菲耶夫
副督察

特务科助理总监。

November 8 38.

Dear Mr. Heaney,

With reference to your letter of
October 29, 1938, I forward herewith for
your information a copy of report regarding
a Russian named Andre Evgenievitch Poliansky.

Yours sincerely,

R. S. Heaney, Esq.,
Passport Office,
H.B.M. Consulate-General.

Andre Evgenievitch Poliansky whose application
for a visa for Australia is enclosed herein.

Yours sincerely,

Rs. **〔此处转录不清〕**
